baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 names day or daylight, while word 3 is a transitive unveiling verb with a feminine object suffix.
baseline_models.mechanism: Day is an active visibility-making interval: its opening in light supplies the medium, and the verb moves an unresolved feminine object from hiddenness into manifestation.

activation_trace.role: The day opening in light supplies the temporal and luminous field of disclosure.
Emergence after hiddenness gives the verb its object-changing action.
Spreading daylight that removes darkness makes the named agent and its revealing action mutually reinforcing.

changed_reading.before: A bare temporal statement: day arrives and the scene is bright.
changed_reading.after: Day acts upon an unresolved feminine object and brings her from concealment into manifest visibility.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The day noun at word 1 and the disclosure verb at word 3 can be joined through their shared imagery of opening a field.
baseline_models.mechanism: Daylight behaves materially: it cuts, widens, and opens a channel through an occluded field, so revelation is spatial clearance rather than brightness merely laid on top.

activation_trace.role: A flowing channel cutting ground supplies the material geometry of daylight advancing through obstruction.
Widening until flow or open space appears turns day into an expanding visual aperture.
Uncovering supplies the result produced by the channel-like opening.

changed_reading.before: Day is a static container in which visibility happens.
changed_reading.after: Day carves and widens a corridor of visibility through what had enclosed the object.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The word-3 verb can denote polishing and clearing sight as well as making an object visible.
baseline_models.mechanism: The action can operate on the medium or faculty of seeing: daylight burnishes perception until the object resolves, rather than only throwing light onto an unchanged observer.

activation_trace.role: The light-opened day supplies the condition under which visual clarification can work.
Polishing a surface and clearing eyesight recasts disclosure as refinement of the perceiving interface.

changed_reading.before: Day illuminates an already available object for a passive viewer.
changed_reading.after: Day clarifies the very conditions of seeing, polishing perception until she can be discerned.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The transitive word-3 verb governs a feminine object suffix and has a branch of deliberate bridal presentation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The object is not merely exposed by ambient light; she is staged and presented before a gaze, giving the clause a relational and ceremonial contour.

activation_trace.role: The opening of day provides the public interval in which presentation becomes possible.
Deliberate bridal unveiling supplies a staged relation among agent, feminine object, and implied beholder.

changed_reading.before: The object simply becomes visible.
changed_reading.after: Day presents her into visibility as an event of display, with an implied beholding position.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The disclosure verb at word 3 also carries departure and expulsion, while the day root can carry widening and opening.
baseline_models.mechanism: Revelation may be subtractive: day makes room by driving away what occupies or conceals the field, so clarity has a cost of displacement.

activation_trace.role: Opening and widening supply the cleared space into which visibility expands.
Departure or expulsion supplies the subtractive means by which the field becomes clear.

changed_reading.before: Light is added to darkness until the object can be seen.
changed_reading.after: Day clears by displacement, forcing concealment out of the field so the object stands exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding solar and midmorning cues give the feminine object a concrete luminous candidate: day manifests the sun or her radiant face rather than an unspecified scene.

activation_trace.role: Manifestation after hiddenness remains the focus action whose object is being identified.
The sun and its radiance supply the nearest feminine luminous entity for the focus suffix.
Emergence into sunlight and appearance make the preceding clause itself a disclosure event.
Clear midmorning radiance sharpens the luminous identity of what day reveals.

structural_cues: 91:1 introduces a grammatically feminine solar antecedent immediately before the focus.
The opening clauses repeat a feminine suffix in tightly parallel oath constructions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sun, emergence into sunlight, clear midmorning radiance, and repeated feminine suffixes. I infer that the focus object preferentially tracks the sun; the whole visible field remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Day manifests an unresolved feminine object.
changed_reading.after: Day actively brings the sun or her radiant face into view, with the broader world still possible as a secondary object.

context_deltas.mechanism: Moonlight and following turn the focus action into one phase of an ordered procession: manifestation is achieved through succession and replacement, not by an isolated burst of light.

activation_trace.role: The bounded daylight interval supplies one distinguishable phase in the procession.
Daylight spreading against darkness gives the phase its revealing effect.
The moon and its sky-light supply a neighboring, distinct mode of illumination.
Following and serial continuation supply the temporal arrow that links luminous phases.

structural_cues: 91:2 and 91:3 share the conditional frame and feminine object suffix.
Moon, day, and night occur as adjacent agents with different relations to the same feminine object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies moonlight, following, and parallel phase clauses. I infer an ordered alternation in which one mode of visibility hands off to another; rhetorical juxtaposition without a strict physical sequence remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Day independently makes the object visible.
changed_reading.after: Day's revealing is a phase-transition within a procession of luminous and obscuring agents.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following night clause supplies the exact inverse operation. Day's disclosure is therefore the active reversal of a cover laid over the same object.

activation_trace.role: Uncovering after hiddenness names the focus-side reversal.

Night as the dark contrary of day supplies the alternating agent.
A cover rising over and concealing something supplies the layer that day removes.

structural_cues: 91:3 and 91:4 are adjacent syntactic mirrors with opposed agents and actions.
Both clauses act transitively on a feminine object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed day and night agents plus uncovering and covering branches. I infer that the two clauses reverse one another on the same object; independent but parallel cosmic images remain a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Day adds illumination to a neutral scene.
changed_reading.after: Day peels back a night-laid covering, so visibility is a reversible contest between disclosure and enclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Building, spreading, and bringing a being to integral form recast daylight as one constructive operation in world-making: it opens and finishes a habitable perceptual field.

Integrity and completion supply the finishing condition of a world made fully perceptible.

structural_cues: The focus is followed by three parallel clauses about sky, earth, and self acted upon through a feminine suffix.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies construction, spreading, completion, and parallel transitive clauses. I infer that daylight participates functionally in world-making by producing perceptual space; a looser catalog of oath objects remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes a daily optical event.
changed_reading.after: Daylight is a constructive act that opens, extends, and completes the world's field of appearance.

context_deltas.mechanism: A non-dominant mapped inventory for the sky root activates visible marking and diagnosis by an observer. Day does more than expose a shape: it marks the object into public legibility.

activation_trace.role: Open notoriety turns manifestation into being unmistakably known.
A visible mark that makes its bearer recognizable supplies the shift from visibility to identification.
An observer reading condition from a sign supplies the diagnostic function of daylight.

structural_cues: The sky clause follows the day clause in the same oath sequence.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a non-dominant mapping with visible marks and observer-readable signs. I infer that daylight can function as a marking system; the dominant elevation-and-sky reading remains the materially stronger alternative.

changed_reading.before: Day makes her visually present.
changed_reading.after: Day makes her condition identifiable and publicly readable, converting appearance into a sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: The self root's dawn-like opening and the rupture root's daybreak image animate the focus: day is an exhalation or release by which the closed world breathes into visibility.

activation_trace.role: Opening and widening until release supplies the expanding motion of the breath image.

The opening of dawn figured like breath directly couples respiration and daybreak.
Daybreak splitting out of night supplies the release boundary.

structural_cues: The oath sequence moves from day and night to a living self.
Opening, spreading, and splitting recur across the cited branch images.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a dawn-like breath opening and daybreak splitting from night. I infer a respiratory arrow from enclosure to release; ordinary visual and temporal readings remain fully live.

changed_reading.before: Daylight spreads as an impersonal optical condition.
changed_reading.after: The world seems to exhale day, opening from nocturnal enclosure into a living field of visibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wide rupture, torn covering, protection, purification, and concealment turn optical revelation into an analogue of moral exposure: daylight makes buried alternatives available without itself choosing between them.

activation_trace.role: Uncovering supplies the focus anchor for bringing concealed material into appearance.
A wide split and release make disclosure forceful rather than merely incremental.
Deviation figured as tearing a veil lets moral breach and optical breach coexist.

structural_cues: 91:8-10 repeatedly act on the same feminine suffix used throughout the opening sequence.
The sequence juxtaposes disclosed alternatives, purification, and burial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rupture, veil-breaking, protection, purity, and concealment. I infer an analogy between daylight exposure and the self becoming morally legible; the cosmic and psychic clauses may instead remain separate domains.

changed_reading.before: Day reveals an external luminous object.
changed_reading.after: Day becomes a model of exposure in which what a self protects, purifies, or buries can be brought into the open.

context_deltas.mechanism: The river-like day, the plough's cut, growth, and nurturing completion form an ecological mechanism: illumination incises an occluded surface so that a viable field can develop.

activation_trace.role: A watercourse cutting ground supplies both flow and incision.
Widening into open space converts the cut into a usable field.
Cleaving and cutting sharpen the material action latent in the focus.
A cultivator splitting earth turns the opening into productive preparation.
Growth and increase supply the result enabled by the opened field.
Nurturing, repairing, and bringing to completion supply sustained cultivation beyond the first cut.

structural_cues: The focus root itself contains a river image, while later roots supply cutting, cultivation, growth, and nurture.
The surah moves from cosmic opening to the success or failure of tending a self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies river-cutting, ploughing, growth, and nurturing completion. I infer that light's opening can be modeled as cultivation; the later success vocabulary need not causally describe daylight.

changed_reading.before: Day passively illuminates a finished field.
changed_reading.after: Day cuts open and irrigates a perceptual field, making growth and self-cultivation imaginable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Overflowing water activates the day root's river branch, while an allotted watering-channel image gives that force a course. Revelation becomes a flood of light that can exceed limits yet still travel through apportioned channels.

activation_trace.role: Abundant flowing water and a ground-cutting channel provide the focus-side hydraulic substrate.
Daylight spreading until darkness is removed converts water flow into a flood of visibility.
Water rising past its bound supplies the force and excess of the disclosure.
The non-dominant mapped branch extends water-overflow into analogous kinds of excess rather than leaving it purely literal.
An allotted share of watering and its channel constrain the flow into a distributive course.

structural_cues: A river image is latent in the focus day root before later water-excess and watering-share cues appear.
The opening cosmic sequence and the later social narrative both organize access to a shared medium.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies river flow, water exceeding bounds, and an allotted channel. I infer a hydraulic model of illumination and its distribution; ordinary moral excess and literal watering remain independent alternatives.

changed_reading.before: Day reveals by evenly increasing light.
changed_reading.after: Day inundates the field with a powerful flow of visibility, at once potentially excessive and channelled into shares.

context_deltas.mechanism: A display can misrepresent its condition, and speech can operate as conjecture. These cues weaken any equation of being manifest with being true: daylight produces evidence, not infallible interpretation.

activation_trace.role: Staged presentation supplies the focus-side possibility that appearance is curated.
Public notoriety distinguishes being widely visible from being correctly understood.
A garment whose appearance misstates its condition supplies a concrete false-display mechanism.
Speech functioning as conjecture supplies interpretive uncertainty after manifestation.

structural_cues: Denial appears twice after the oath sequence has made cosmic phenomena maximally visible.
The narrative distinguishes what is shown or said from how hearers construe it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deceptive appearance, conjectural speech, and repeated denial. I infer that manifestation is evidentiary rather than self-interpreting; the deception branches may instead concern only human response.

changed_reading.before: Once day unveils her, visibility guarantees truth.
changed_reading.after: Day makes her available as evidence, but display, speech, and the observer can still distort what the appearance means.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stirring what was motionless turns disclosure into activation: day does not only reveal a waiting world but rouses its forms from latency into visible activity.

activation_trace.role: The opening daylight interval supplies the activating condition.
Emergence from hiddenness supplies the transition from latency to appearance.
Rousing the still from rest supplies the kinetic arrow added to visual emergence.

The focus verb and the stirring branch both encode transition from latency to actuality.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visual emergence and the rousing of what was still. I infer that day activates as well as illuminates; the later rising may remain morally specific rather than cosmically analogous.

changed_reading.before: Day exposes a world that was already fully active.
changed_reading.after: Day summons latent forms into visible activity, making revelation also an awakening.

context_deltas.mechanism: A thing's capacity to indicate and the arrival of a messenger recast daylight as nonverbal testimony. Its unveiling communicates a claim before any spoken warning occurs.

activation_trace.role: Open, unmistakable notoriety makes the revealed object publicly communicative.
A thing's own indication functioning as speech supplies nonverbal signification.

structural_cues: The spoken warning in 91:13 follows a series of oath-images that have already acted as evidence.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a thing's indicative speech, a messenger, and public manifestation. I infer that daylight communicates by showing; the cosmic oaths may instead only authorize the later verbal message.

changed_reading.before: Daylight is mute illumination.
changed_reading.after: By unveiling her, day makes a nonverbal declaration whose visible object functions as testimony.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wounding, opening a gap, eradication, and equalization strengthen the subtractive baseline: making a field clear can mean cutting through it, emptying it, and leveling what resisted.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expulsion, wounding, a gap, eradication, and leveling. I infer a shared clearance mechanism that exposes the violence latent in making clear; cosmic illumination and punitive destruction may instead be deliberate opposites.

changed_reading.before: Day's clearing is benign and additive.
changed_reading.after: Day's unveiling can be imagined as a forceful clearance that cuts an aperture and displaces whatever maintained concealment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Tail, end, consequence, succession, and return make the temporal clause consequential. An unveiling leaves a remainder and enters a cycle; it is not exhausted in the instant of seeing.

The tail or end of a thing supplies a trailing remainder after the event.

The opening alternation of luminous phases is closed by vocabulary of outcome and recurrence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded day, tail, succession, outcome, and return. I infer that every unveiling produces an aftereffect and re-enters a cycle; the final outcome may instead refer only to the punitive narrative.

changed_reading.before: Day's unveiling is a complete, self-contained instant.
changed_reading.after: Disclosure leaves a trace, entails an outcome, and recurs within a sequence whose next phase can cover the object again.

It remains anchored in the exact focus root and gains a coherent mechanism from unveiling, speech, message, and denial; downstream prose should present it only as a latent personification in which exposure admonishes, not as a replacement lexical gloss for day.

surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-3 verb makes hidden states manifest and can make their bearer openly known.

changed_reading.after: Daylight can also figure the moment an inward condition writes itself visibly onto a living bearer.

strongest_changes: The neighboring sun and night clauses turn the focus into an active uncovering of a likely solar object and the exact reversal of nocturnal covering.
River, widening, rupture, ploughing, overflow, and watering cues make daylight a material flow that cuts, irrigates, and sometimes inundates a field of visibility.
Construction, spreading, and completion recast disclosure as a world-making operation rather than a passive clock interval.
Moral concealment, denial, speech, and message make visibility evidentiary and communicative without guaranteeing truthful interpretation.
Later cutting, eradication, and equalization keep a disturbing co-reading alive in which making clear can involve displacement or violent clearance.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah sustained several irreducible mechanisms at once: ordinary solar unveiling, reversible cover removal, spatial aperture, hydraulic flow, polished perception, public signification, cultivated growth, and exploratory ceremonial, admonitory, predatory, and destructive presentations. The most productive surprise came from allowing the day root's non-day branches and the disclosure root's display, expulsion, polishing, and gaze branches to remain active under context rather than collapsing them into generic brightness.
remaining_uncertainties: The feminine object most naturally tracks the sun in the immediate sequence, but the whole visible field, the earth, or a deliberately unresolved object remain possible.
The exact amount of causal force in the sequence is uncertain: many arrows from context branch to focus mechanism are abductive analogies rather than grammatical entailments.
Non-dominant mapped roots produce valuable legibility and overflow activations, but their distance requires explicit qualification.
Ceremonial, predatory, rebuking, stealth-taking, and violent-clearance readings are coherent latent overlays, not proposed replacements for the ordinary daytime sense.
Visibility may disclose truth, stage a manipulable appearance, or merely supply evidence; the packet keeps all three epistemic readings live.
